QuestInfo.name: [Temple of Time] Seeking Lost Memories
QuestInfo.0: The Memory Keeper explained that you must return to your beginnings to regain your lost memory. Your adventures started with your longtime friend Jay.
QuestInfo.1: Jay spoke of the painful past from your memories. You cut the call short. Maybe sharing the painful past is what friendship is about.
